selection: First both-opponent-pass-constrained focal multi-choice state per baseline seat/mix; up to four unique policy-proposed legal moves. No true opponent hand used for selection.
sampling: Independent deterministic training/evaluation salts; conditional and uniform training, both-pass-compatible matched evaluation worlds; fixed continuation policies.
limitations: Provisional number-lock; block winner, loneZero, bust/101-match unresolved. Finish-first != match win. Sparse selected positions; candidate-limited; 8-world training may overfit; evaluation-oracle regret is optimistic. Uniform pass-compatible prior ignores opponent action likelihood. Deal-cluster exploratory 95% intervals uncorrected. Preregistered conditional-vs-uniform primary comparison; stratified subgroup CIs exploratory and uncorrected.
nextAction: Independent seeds >=1563440 with 24+ training worlds; stratify by pass strength and opening-switch; authenticate branch and block-winner fixtures.

preRegisteredStrata.definition: Pass strength is forbiddenNext + forbiddenOther, weak <=4, strong >=5. Opening-switch means conditional adviser vs branch-control differs in double-sequence action type. Exploratory unadjusted deal-cluster normal CIs; selected position strata, not causal.
